sections.description: A full web version of the noodled note-taking app. Markdown notes with rich editing, family sharing, PIN login, GitHub sync, Plaud voice import, and 50+ power tools. Install on any WordPress site.
sections.changelog:
1.1.17

  • Security: IDOR fixes on all note/attachment endpoints
  • Security: File upload type blocking and size limits
  • Security: PIN brute force rate limiting
  • Performance: Autosave no longer reloads all notes
  • White-label branding (custom name, tagline, accent color)
  • First-run setup wizard
  • Self-registration with optional admin approval
  • Configurable app URL path
  • Cache busting for SiteGround/CDN
  • 50+ editor and organization features
